e4s-g1-00.idea: Remove corner and central givens so fewer rows, columns and boxes are nearly complete.

e4s-g1-01.idea: Remove scattered givens to weaken the easy singles and force longer chains.

e4s-g1-02.idea: Remove edge givens, leaving fewer direct eliminations along rows and columns.

e4s-g1-03.idea: Thin out the givens in the lower-left and middle-left areas to lengthen deductions.

e4s-g1-04.idea: Break up the nearly complete row 8 and the left side.

e4s-g1-05.idea: Remove givens that give quick singles in row 2 and the box and row corners.

e4s-g1-06.idea: Remove givens in the left columns so no column or box is close to complete.

e4s-g1-07.idea: Remove givens from different boxes to spread the difficulty and make deductions longer.

e4s-g1-08.idea: Remove edge givens that anchor easy singles, leaving the grid sparser.

e4s-g1-09.idea: Break up the dense row 8 and central clues so more cross-unit reasoning is needed.

e4s-g1-10.idea: Remove givens that give easy singles in the left columns and the bottom rows, so more cells need multi-step eliminations.

e4s-g2-00.idea: Remove givens that create easy singles in nearly full units.

e4s-g2-01.idea: Fewer givens with the clues spread thinner across boxes.

e4s-g2-02.idea: Remove central column givens so the repeating pattern is harder to spot.

e4s-g2-03.idea: Remove corner givens to reduce early entry points.

e4s-g2-04.idea: Thin out row 5 and the bottom row to remove easy singles.

e4s-g2-05.idea: Remove column 4 givens so progress needs longer chains.

e4s-g2-06.idea: Remove central givens so fewer cells fall to direct singles.

e4s-g2-07.idea: Fewer givens in different boxes, none of the units nearly complete.

e4s-g2-08.idea: Remove givens from nearly filled rows to weaken singles.

e4s-g2-09.idea: Spread removals across boxes to leave fewer easy entry points.

e4s-g2-10.idea: Remove givens from row 2 and neighbouring boxes so the row 2 cells need longer chains of deduction.

e4s-g3-00.idea: Strip the nearly complete row 8 and other easy singles so more cells need deeper elimination.

e4s-g3-01.idea: Remove givens scattered across different boxes so no unit is close to complete.

e4s-g3-02.idea: Fewer givens in an already sparse grid, which forces longer chains of deduction.

e4s-g3-03.idea: Remove column 1 givens and a central given to weaken the easy entry points.

e4s-g3-04.idea: Dismantle the nearly full rows 5 and 9 so there are no quick row singles.

e4s-g3-05.idea: Remove givens that anchor the empty row 8 and the middle band so it needs multi-step logic.

e4s-g3-06.idea: Open up the nearly complete row 7 and thin the other rows.

e4s-g3-07.idea: Remove givens in column 2 and the center so fewer digits are placed early.

e4s-g3-08.idea: Remove givens from the nearly full rows 3 and 9 to make singles scarce.

e4s-g3-09.idea: Remove central and edge givens so progress needs subtler eliminations.

e4s-g3-10.idea: Remove givens from the nearly complete row 5 and from the row 4 and box 4 area so fewer singles are available.

e4s-g4-00.idea: Remove givens that give easy singles in row 8, box 8 and the centre column, so more cells need multi-step deductions.

e4s-g4-01.idea: Remove several givens spread across rows, columns and boxes to cut easy singles and force longer deduction chains.

e4s-g4-02.idea: Remove givens in the middle and right columns so the repeating-pattern solution is harder to read off.

e4s-g4-03.idea: Remove givens that make the 8s and 2s in the top and middle easy to place.

e4s-g4-04.idea: Fewer givens in the lower right and top middle, so more cells need multi-step elimination.

e4s-g4-05.idea: Open up the center columns and row 4, which was already error-prone, so fewer cells can be filled immediately.

e4s-g4-06.idea: Scatter removals across many units so no row, column or box is close to complete.
